title: Certify the approved expression suite under adversarial conditions
objective: Prove that the canonical Mez expression, component and website-motion grammar remains complete, legible and operable across hostile receiver, content, preference, input and runtime conditions without reopening approved design decisions.

included: long copy, translation expansion and RTL
reduced motion and no-WebGL static equivalence
missing media, missing optional data and unpriced offers
keyboard, focus, touch and semantic status
excluded: changing canonical product or gradient assignments
changing approved component anatomy or motion grammar

acceptance: one schema-validated canonical contract defines six suites and fourteen unique representative scenarios
all seven canonical expression/component dependencies are hash pinned and unchanged
canonical build is deterministic and carries bounded productionAuthority true
one interactive receiver exposes width, text scale, content and runtime controls
fixtures include reflow, zoom, localization, RTL, reduced motion, no-WebGL, missing media, keyboard, touch, recovery, unpriced and one-live-core proof
review UI exports the bounded human-gate payload
mobile, desktop, static and no-WebGL modes retain complete states with zero page overflow

verification.passCondition: canonical source validates with exactly 6 suites and 14 unique scenarios
all approved expression hashes remain immutable and the canonical package rebuilds deterministically
240px receivers and 320px through 1440px viewports have no page overflow, clipped controls or broken reading order
200/400 percent text, long content, localization and RTL retain complete hierarchy and actions
reduced-motion, static, no-WebGL and missing-media modes retain product identity, meaning and actions
keyboard, visible focus, escape/focus restoration, touch targets and non-colour meaning are intact
Olli accepts the certification boundary and documented residual consumer risks

humanGate.approvalQuestion: Does this proof certify the approved Mez expression system under realistic stress without reopening its locked visual, component or motion decisions?

stopConditions: an inherited canonical expression hash changes
a defect repair changes approved visual direction or component anatomy
more than one live product material mounts in one viewport
reduced motion or no-WebGL removes meaning or an action
a fixture invents production pricing or provider behaviour
the work expands into CMP-01 navigation, the golden homepage or a consumer repository
the candidate is described as canonical before the human gate
notes: EXP-08 is a certification phase, not a design round.
Representative fixtures concentrate on the highest-risk seams rather than reproducing every approved specimen.
Olli approved the bounded certification on 23 July 2026 through DEC-EXPRESSION-STRESS-CERTIFICATION-001.
Passing this repository proof does not replace later consumer-framework and provider integration proof.
